mapper.select:
select p.PROD_ID id, p.PROD_NAME text from CHB_PRD_BASEINFO p where p.`STATUS` = 'E'
and p.PROD_ID IN (#{initValue})
and ( p.PROD_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or p.PROD_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))

select p.PROD_ID as prodId,/** 产品代码**/ p.PROD_NAME as prodName,/** 产品名称**/ p.REG_CODE as regCode,/** 理财信息系统登记编码**/ p.OPERATE_MODE as operateMode,/** 产品运作模式**/ p.IVSTORIENTATION as ivstorientation,/** 投资性质**/ p.CASH_PRIN_CCY as cashPrinCcy,/** 兑付本金币种**/ p.RISK_LEVEL as riskLevel,/** 产品风险等级**/ p.RAISE_TYPE as raiseType,/** 募集方式**/ p.VDATE as vdate,/** 起息日**/ p.MDATE as mdate,/** 到期日**/ p.BUSI_ACCT_NO as busiAcctNo,/** 资金托管账号**/ p.IN_DEP_NAME as inDepName,/** 境内托管机构名称**/ p.OUT_DEP_NAME as outDepName, /** 境外托管机构名称**/ case when p.IN_DEP_NAME is not null and p.OUT_DEP_NAME is not null then concat_ws('、', p.IN_DEP_NAME, p.OUT_DEP_NAME) when p.IN_DEP_NAME is not null and p.OUT_DEP_NAME is null then p.IN_DEP_NAME when p.IN_DEP_NAME is null and p.OUT_DEP_NAME is not null then p.OUT_DEP_NAME else '' end as depName, /** 境内托管机构名称 + 境外托管机构名称**/ '华夏理财有限责任公司' as managerName /** 产品管理人**/ from CHB_PRD_BASEINFO p where p.PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT a.PROD_ID as prodId, a.ASSETTYPE2 as assettype2, ROUND(a.ASSETVALUE_A / b.totalAssetvalueA, 2) as percentAssetvalueA, ROUND(a.ASSETVALUE_B / b.totalAssetvalueB, 2) as percentAssetvalueB FROM chb_month_asset_position a, (SELECT PROD_ID, SUM(ASSETVALUE_A) AS totalAssetvalueA, SUM(ASSETVALUE_B) AS totalAssetvalueB FROM chb_month_asset_position where ENDDATE = #{endReportDate,jdbcType=DATE} GROUP BY PROD_ID) b WHERE a.PROD_ID = b.PROD_ID AND a.PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND a.ENDDATE = #{endReportDate,jdbcType=DATE}

SELECT a.PROD_ID as prodId, b.ASSET_NAME as assetName, a.ASSETTYPE2 as assettype2, CONCAT(ROUND(a.ASSETVALUE_B / c.totalAssetvalueB, 2), '', '%') as percentAssetvalueB, a.ASSETVALUE_B as assetvalueB, b.CCY as ccy FROM chb_month_asset_position a, chb_asset_info b, (SELECT PROD_ID, SUM(ASSETVALUE_B) AS totalAssetvalueB FROM chb_month_asset_position where ENDDATE = #{endReportDate,jdbcType=DATE} GROUP BY PROD_ID) c where a.PROD_ID = c.PROD_ID and a.ASSET_CODE = b.ASSET_CODE AND a.ENDDATE = #{endReportDate,jdbcType=DATE} order by a.ASSETVALUE_B Limit 10;

select distinct t.PROD_ID as prodId, a.ASSET_NAME as assetName,/** 资产名称**/ a.ASSET_TYPE2 as assetType2,/** 资产/负债二级类别**/ a.FINANCIE as financie,/** 融资人**/ a.ASSET_YIELD as assetYield,/** 项目收益率(利率)%**/ a.MDATE as mdate /** 到期日 **/ from CHB_INVEST_TRADE t, CHB_ASSET_INFO a where t.ASSET_CODE = a.ASSET_CODE and a.`STATUS` = 'E' and t.`STATUS` = 'E' and a.ASSET_TYPE2 in ( select SRCFIELD1 from chb_type_mapping_ex where MAPPINGCODE = 'ChbInvestOperation001' ) /** 指定非标资产的类别**/ and t.PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.DEALDATE = #{endReportDate,jdbcType=DATE} order by a.ASSET_TYPE2, a.ASSET_CODE
